gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supple: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement has round forms like open parentheses and a middle band so tall the lines look stocky. And Revalia stretches out above it, bold and expressive, its widely separated letters strolling along at a relaxed pace.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa keeps its round letters wide and inviting. Revalia is the loud one here, a bold display face with a relaxed stride, and the body font's approachable openness is what makes that loudness easy to take.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC reads with large open counters and curves that flare outward rather than curling in, a friendly, approachable texture. But Revalia is where the personality lives, bold and expressive, with a g whose lower curve stays open.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-telugu: A relaxed stride across widely separated letters is the first thing Revalia gives you, bold and expressive. Noto Sans Telugu follows with a high-set midline and counters that stay connected to the outside, so the whole pairing feels professional.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-thai: Approachable from the first line, Noto Sans Thai swells its lowercase like inflated glass beads, with rounded letters left open. And Revalia pushes the other way, bold and expressive, with a relaxed stride across widely separated letters.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Clean and professional, Noto Sans Thai Looped has tall lowercase bodies that look bold. Revalia, a display face with an open-curved g and widely separated letters, takes the headline while the body font keeps its curve terminals spacious below.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Clean and open, Noto Sans Tifinagh fills the line with rounded bowls that look like inflated shapes, quietly inviting. Revalia is the one that gets to be bold and expressive.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Contemporary in feel, Noto Sans Tirhuta cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap and lets a dominant x-height carry the line. Revalia's bold, relaxed display letters give it a lively partner.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: A tall band of letters with short stalks above gives Revalia its bold, expressive look. Noto Sans Ugaritic sits below with very little gap between x-height and cap height, and open letter mouths like unjoined chalk arcs.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-vai: Big, loose and bold, Revalia stretches its widely separated letters across the line with an open-curved g. Noto Sans Vai sets words as solid blocks instead of skylines, with generous space where curves meet the stem.
